test_title: PYST 1: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order forming a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**
 
A. He had agreed to feed him, pay him twelve rupees a month, and find him somewhere to stay.
 
B. A month's salary was paid in advance.
 
C. Fotik had learned to handle his job quite well in the last five days.
 
D. Upen Babu was a good man who had helped a lot.
solution:
The correct answer is **CDAB**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• **Sentence C** seems to be an introductory statement, thus it should come first in order. 
• The next sentence is **Sentence D** which speaks about Upen Babu who had helped Fotik a lot. 
• The third sentence should be the agreement made between Upen Babu and Fotik which is expressed in **sentence A**. 
• **Sentence B** comes last in the series which mentions that after agreeing to feed Fotik and paying him 12 rupees a month, the first month's salary was paid in advance. 
• Thus, the correct order of jumbled sentences is given in **option 2**. 

 **Correct Paragraph:**__ *Fotik had learned to handle his job quite well in the last five days. Upen Babu was a good man who had helped a lot. He had agreed to feed him, pay him twelve rupees a month, and find him somewhere to stay. A month's salary was paid in advance.*
